svg.title: ruflo tui: the console in your terminal
svg.desc: A looping recording of the optional standalone ruflo terminal UI cycling through five read-only pages: Overview, Cost, Swarm, Events and Missions. Sample project and sample agents only.

g.text: Overview: what ruflo is doing in this project
Cost: budget and spend. n/a means not measured here
Swarm: topology and agents at a glance
Events: swarm, memory and mod activity (quiet in a new project)
Missions: the mission record, read-only (none yet in this sample)
